related: negative regulation of gene expression via CpG island methylation
negative regulation of gene expression via chromosomal CG dinucleotide methylation

definition: An epigenetic gene regulation mechanism that negatively regulates gene expression by methylation of cytosine residues in chromosomal CpG islands. CpG islands are genomic regions that contain a high frequency of the CG dinucleotide associated with the transcription start site of genes.
label: negative regulation of gene expression via chromosomal CpG island methylation
